designationHistory.indexText: Congress established the Tetlin National Wildlife Refuge, about 700,000 acres, in the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act, which President Jimmy Carter signed on December 2, 1980.

authority.citation: Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act, Public Law 96-487, sec. 302(8), 94 Stat. 2371

designationHistory.note: Pass A (FWS Realty establishment record and fws.gov: created in 1980 by ANILCA) and Pass B (statute text, sec. 302(8), in the Statutes at Large on govinfo) agree.
